incoming.name: Benjamin Britten
incoming.excerpt: He had already begun work on his opera Peter Grimes, and its premiere at Sadler's Wells in 1945 was his greatest success so far.

outgoing.name: London
outgoing.excerpt: It was first performed at Sadler's Wells in London on June 7, 1945, conducted by Reginald Goodall.

outgoing.name: United Kingdom
outgoing.excerpt: It is still widely performed, both in the UK and internationally and is considered part of the standard repertoire.
